svg.title: slipway-agents architecture v1.3.0
svg.desc: Pipeline lengkap v1.3.0 dengan plugin enforcement layer, slash commands, dynamic doc detection, P0/P1/P2 priority, dan ADR conflict guard.

g.text: reads slipway.json → enforces model per agent at runtime
phases + dep graph + S/M/L + P0 first

svg.text: primary → fallback → category → frontmatter resolution chain
drafting-table ranks requirements; rigger puts P0 in earliest phases
bootstrap-from-prd scans PRD signals → generates doc 11, 12... as needed
per-project model override, gitignored, takes precedence over slipway.json
